description: List the tenant's 3PL clients (publishers/owners): id, name, code, active/entitled flags, management mode, order horizon, and the per-client external-feed and run-planning overrides. Active-only by default (set includeInactive to see all). Optional name/code search substring; paged (Total pre-paging + limit/offset, default 100, max 500). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token on a 3PL tenant.

includeInactive.description: Include inactive clients too (default false = active only).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against client name or code.

name: list_clients
title: List Clients
